messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DEDICATED POOL ALERT: pool `saffron-dedicated-7` (tenant: ZenithHealth) reporting GPU utilization 100%, queue_depth=412, p99_latency=2.7s. Paging oncall.

carla (oncall): ack. I'm taking this. @nathan @pavan @meera please join. Any known maintenance or deploys?

nathan (infra): no planned deploys. Looking at pool control plane: 16 gpus, all hosted in us-central1, autoscaler attempted +3 nodes at 1789994470 -> failed with `region_capacity_exhausted`. Logs: `ProviderError: insufficient capacity in us-central1-a for a100-80gb`.

pavan: tenant is ZenithHealth (HIPAA). Their contract forbids spill to multi-tenant hosted nodes (burst_to_shared=false). We need explicit customer OK for any outbound spill. meera, can you reach out to the account?

meera (acct): pinging reza@zenithhealth. Notifying legal/compliance per contract before any spill.

reza (ZenithHealth SRE): we see timeouts on our side. We cannot allow data to leave our dedicated VPC. We can approve adding nodes inside our VPC if you can provision within our region, or accept temporary model-fidelity fallbacks for non-sensitive jobs. We cannot permit cross-tenant burst.

carla (oncall): thanks. Two parallel paths: 1) immediate live mitigations to reduce latency and failure for critical routes; 2) provision extra nodes inside customer VPC/colo if infra can. Nathan -- can we attach any warm standby baremetal or colo nodes to this pool now?

nathan (infra): we have two colo blades reserved for Zenith in our Chicago colo (tagged zenith-reserve-01/02). I can attach them; they are a40-class. Will need a quick network attach and PKI boot. Est ~8-12 minutes to register. Attempting now: `infractl attach-node --pool saffron-dedicated-7 --node zenith-reserve-01`

deploy-bot: infractl: attach request submitted -> provisioning keys -> bootstrapping network (1789994565).

pavan: runtime mitigations in the meantime: 1) prioritize `api-live` route requests and pin to low-latency QoS class; 2) evict `bulk-ingest` and `offline-eval` pods; 3) enable cheap-quant model fallback for non-PII labeled embeds. Be careful with labeling — ask the customer which labels are safe.

carla (oncall): agreed. Implementing prioritization and eviction.

runtime-bot: applying QoS policy: `policy apply --pool saffron-dedicated-7 --rule "route==/v1/api-live => qos=high, max_concurrency=120"` (1789994590).

nathan (infra): attach progress: zenith-reserve-01 registered (1789994812), zenith-reserve-02 registering (1789994860).

meera (acct): reza, quick question: can Zenith authorize temporary model-fallback for `bulk-ingest` only? That would keep clinical endpoints untouched. We will record approval and bill per emergency addendum.

reza (ZenithHealth SRE): we can approve model-fallback for pods labeled `non-phi` only. We'll send a signed approval email within 15 minutes with exact label list. Approval code: ZH-EMG-20M.

pavan: good. Starting evict + fallback for `non-phi` pods. Command snippets:
```
kubectl get pods -l workload=bulk-ingest,phi=false -n saffron | xargs -r kubectl cordon
rdctl route update --pool saffron-dedicated-7 --match 'labels.phi==false' --set model=embed-quant-lite
```

ops-bot: eviction queued: 120 pods. First wave terminating (1789994920).

carla (oncall): note: we'll reject huge ctx payloads for chat during emergency to cap resource usage: respond 413 + Retry-After for requests > 32000 tokens. Pushing rule now.

runtime-bot: policy updated: max_tokens_chat=32000 -> smaller requests accepted; large requests receive 413 (1789994945).

nathan (infra): zenith-reserve-02 joined (1789995028). Both nodes registered and ready. Starting KV warm-up and model warm copies. Running: `tools/warm_kv --pool saffron-dedicated-7 --tenant zenithhealth --hot 1500`

deploy-bot: warm-up job started -> 1500 prefixes enqueued (1789995080).

ops-bot: metrics snapshot (1789995120): queue_depth -> 168, p95 latency -> 520ms, error_rate -> 1.6%. Noticeable improvement from p99 2.7s -> p99 980ms.

meera (acct): filing emergency billing ticket FIN-2026-088. Note: customer approval ZH-EMG-20M attached once received.

reza (ZenithHealth SRE): we sent the signed approval email for `non-phi` model-fallback and the attach of colo nodes. We will follow up with compliance for the audit trail. Please attach all audit logs.

carla (oncall): capturing audit: `auditctl list --filter "saffron-dedicated-7" --since 1789994400 > /tmp/INC-2026-233-audit.log` and attaching to INC-2026-233.

pavan: also enabled a soft-degrade path for very expensive embeddings (token > 2048) to accept them asynchronously and push to a slower job queue with job-id and webhook callback to the tenant when ready. That reduces blocking on critical RPCs.

runtime-bot: async-queue created: `job-queue: saffron-offload-async` (1789995200).

ops-bot: metrics (1789995320): queue_depth=60, p95=300ms, error_rate=0.7%. API-live routes back to normal SLAs.

reza (ZenithHealth SRE): we're seeing customer dashboards recover. Thanks. We still have a backlog of bulk ingest; fine as long as it doesn't touch Phi flows.

meera (acct): once incident closes we'll send invoice and reconciliation per contract. FIN ticket updated.

carla (oncall): setting a 20-minute emergency window starting now. We'll revert temporary model-fallback and eviction after window unless Zenith requests extension. timer_end=1789995712. Handoff: @pavan will watch after timer expires.

ops-bot: scheduled revert job registered -> revert at 1789995712 unless extend flag set.

pavan: taking active watch at 1789995340. I'll check metrics and customer channel. If Zenith requests extension, we'll follow process: recorded approval + extension code.

nathan (infra): attaching audit snippet to ticket:
```
[1789994812] action=attach-node pool=saffron-dedicated-7 node=zenith-reserve-01 user=nathan reason="emergency attach"
[1789995028] action=attach-node pool=saffron-dedicated-7 node=zenith-reserve-02 user=nathan
```

carla (oncall): good work team. Follow-ups: 1) postmortem + RFO (infra & runtime) on capacity planning, 2) evaluate adding permanent headroom for Zenith (acct+product), 3) automate pre-spike quota checks for VPC/ENI with alerts. Assigning to infra/routing/acct.

pavan: noted. Will file RUNTIME-899 for async offload and model-fallback gating.

ops-bot: incident ticket INC-2026-233 updated with timeline and artifacts.

carla (oncall): closing active paging. Handing final watch to pavan at 1789995400. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

-- end thread --
